categories.name: Account/Password
first_steps: Confirm the exact error message the user sees at login.
Check if the account is locked out (repeated bad password attempts).
Reset the password and force a change at next logon.
Unlock the account if locked.

categories.name: Network/VPN
first_steps: Confirm whether the issue is on-site or remote (VPN-dependent).
Check if other users on the same network/VPN are affected (isolated vs. widespread).
Verify the user's VPN client is up to date and credentials haven't expired.
Check basic connectivity (ping gateway, DNS resolution) before escalating.

categories.name: Hardware
first_steps: Confirm power source and cable connections.
Try a basic restart of the device.
Check Device Manager for driver errors if the device isn't recognized.
Determine if this is a single device or affects multiple users (points to a shared resource issue).

categories.name: Software/Access
common_symptoms: needs access to a shared drive or folder
first_steps: Confirm the exact error message and when it started happening.
Check if the user has the correct group membership for the resource.
Try restarting the application before deeper troubleshooting.
Confirm whether this requires a manager/access approval before granting.

categories.name: Email
first_steps: Confirm whether this is affecting all email or specific senders/recipients.
Check mailbox storage quota.
Verify the account isn't locked or password-expired (email failures are often a symptom of an account issue).
Check for outages on the mail server/service if this is affecting multiple users.
